title: Compact Railway Hopper Wagon
description: Original static railway hopper wagon with one continuous thick open shell: a wide upper mouth, four inward-sloping interior walls and a true bottom-discharge throat. One fixed partly withdrawn steel gate leaves a visible clear opening; two guide rails and four slope-matched brackets attach it to an open underframe. Four independently editable flat steel treads, inner flanges and hubs use two fixed transverse axles. Metres, source Z up, long axis Y; flange-bottom origin. Tread centres X plus/minus .54 m, Y plus/minus .76 m, local tread bottom Z=.04 m. Place at Z=.16 m on the original 1.00 m clear-gauge straight track with head top Z=.20 m. The body is newly authored, not a reskinned flatbed. Three solid PBR materials and editable static components. No moving gate, bulk-material unloading, animation, continuous wheel motion, dynamic coupling, load, stability, physics, railway operations, engineering or safety certification.
